transcriptText:
Hi! I am Tom Arne, the founder of Klarpakke. 

 We are incredibly happy to have you on the journey. Our goal is to make crypto trading understandable and profitable for everyone, without the usual 'hype'. 

 You now have access to our paper trading simulator with 1 million NOK in virtual funds, so you can practice completely risk-free before moving on to real trading. Good luck!
